questions.stem: What is the mass of 1 mole of carbon dioxide (CO₂)? (Ar: C = 12, O = 16)
questions.explanation: The mass of 1 mole of any substance equals its Mr in grams. Mr of CO₂ = 12 + (2 × 16) = 44, so 1 mole of CO₂ has a mass of 44 g.

questions.stem: How many molecules are in 2 moles of a substance?
questions.explanation: Number of molecules = n × NA = 2 × 6.02 × 10²³ = 1.204 × 10²⁴ molecules. Each mole contains 6.02 × 10²³ particles, so 2 moles contain twice that number.
